Guidance & outlook: Strong collections and healthy growth in construction spend enabled us to generate net operating cash flows of INR81 crores during Q1 FY27, further strengthening our financial position and reflecting the resilience of our business model.
Looking ahead, our existing project portfolio provides strong cash flow visibility with estimated operating cash flows of over INR5,119 crores expected to be realized over the next 4 to 5 years.
For the first quarter of FY27, the company reported revenue of INR318 crores compared with INR102 crores in the corresponding quarter of previous year.
Growth & demand: We have started the year with a very strong Q1 with presales of INR432 crores, which is a 147% growth year-on-year.
Our bookings for the quarter grew by around 147% year-on-year basis, reflecting the strength of the underlying business model, our current portfolio and continued momentum across our core markets.

Our launch pipeline remain s robust with a couple of launches expected in the current quarter and a str ong lineup of additional la unches planned over the balance of the year, providing a solid platform for sustained bookings growth.
Margins & costs: Adjusted EBITDA stood at INR150 crores versus INR25 crores in the previous year.

So we expect to reach a bookings growth of 35% to 40% over previous year, business development of INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores during this year and EBITDA margins on new sales in the range of 22% to 25%.
But normally, I think our guidance is about 25% EBITDA margin on our portfolio.
Capex & expansion: Of course, the upfront capex will be higher in that case.
So Prisha, for this year, like I said, one project in Ahmedabad, we are definitely looking at launching, one of the new projects that we had acquired, which is in Vastrapur in Ahmedabad.
One of them already, in fact, which has received approval is the new Sarjapur project that we had acquired.
Balance sheet & cash: Net debt to equity has re mained at 0.29x, leaving enough headroom to raise fresh debt while maintaini ng healthy debt equity ratio .
But when we are talking about INR5,100 crores of cash flows, which are probably sitting from unsold inventory plus the balance collectible.

So Prisha, if you see generally our quarterly run rate, so if you probably were analyzing our operating cash flow, we can do about INR400 crores to INR500 crores of cash flow, which can come from our operating business itself.
Risks & challenges: Speaking of macro trends, India remains one of the fastest-growing major economies supported by strong domestic fundamentals like infrastructure investment, favorable demographics and urbanization despite the global uncertainty.

For FY26, we reported revenues of INR564 crores as against INR713 crores last year.

So while we are expecting FY27 numbers to be better from a reporting accounting perspective, I don't want to give an exact guidance on this particular thing, but we do expect to show strong growth over what we have reported in the FY26 financial year.
